conflict_resolutions.FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: The dossier flags that the sources read as both a whole and a partial ending for EO 12932. Resolution: EO 12932 revokes this order by number in a single sentence that names eight orders and also terminates the national emergency declared in EO 12775, so it is a whole ending. Earlier partial provisions held for some of these orders (revocations to the extent inconsistent in later Haiti orders) are recorded as later events of the clauses they touch; each is conditional on inconsistency and none is shown to extinguish a clause, so none is an end.

research_rationale:
EO 12922 of June 21, 1994 (Blocking Property of Certain Haitian Nationals), read in full in the held Federal Register text (59 FR 32645, Federal Register of June 23, 1994; machine-extracted text layer). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1994-06-21). The order blocks property of Haitian nationals resident in Haiti and of other persons subject to earlier Haiti blocking orders, bars evasion, defines terms, authorizes Treasury regulations and states its effective time. Inventory: I confirm the dossier's ten clauses as complete (the Sec. 4 span also holds Sec. 5, and Sec. 6 is split into a bare heading and items (a) and (b)). EO 12932 revokes the order by number effective 12:01 a.m. EDT October 16, 1994. Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning. Machine hits for this order: current-law:usc 0, current-law:ecfr 0, later-events:ofr_catalog 4. The packet's by-number scan of held order texts (LOOKUPS) was read for this order; no held text other than EO 12932 changes it.

savings.reason: EO 12932 states that the termination of the national emergency does not affect any action taken or proceeding pending, any action or proceeding based on an act committed before its effective date, or any rights or duties that matured or penalties incurred before it. Those preserved effects, and any Treasury regulations or licenses issued under the order, are accrued consequences or separate administrative acts; they are not commands of this order. No held source shows an independent standing command of this order after 1994-10-16.
